rows.grounds: numeral element forming a compound with the following noun
locative plural indicating location within a large number
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (diagram/device) in locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to affliction

items.question: What affliction befalls beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
These thousands are womb-diagrams serving as loci.
items.inference: Existence within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams entails a state of torment.
uncertainties: The specific subjects who are tormented are not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
